source: bendcad pmi check / stack / fits on the built HUMPHREY-1 parts (ISO GPS semantics; fits per ISO 286 with each part grown by its own material)

rows.name: stator
rows.out:
pmi node 4202 items 5
datum A ok n4202.c0.wall.0.0 plane
tol fl flatness conforms actual 0 certified
dim shroud nominal 87.29240248939433 zone [87.28740248939434, 87.29740248939433]
dim rdc_ro nominal 119 zone [118.995, 119.005]
state cold grow 1
pmi ok 5 items

pmi node 4202 stacks 1 states 1
